description: A utility class for generating and validating JWT tokens, including signing and verification methods, key management, and expiration checks.

classes.name: JwtHelper
classes.description: An abstract utility class for creating, signing, and validating JWT tokens with support for different key types and expiration management.

methods.name: getBytes
methods.description: Converts a secret string into its UTF-8 byte array representation.

methods.name: setSharedSecret
methods.description: Sets a shared secret key for signing JWTs, requiring at least 32 bytes.

methods.name: setPrivateKey
methods.description: Loads an RSA or EC private key from a PEM file for signing tokens.

methods.name: setPublicKey
methods.description: Loads a public key from a PEM file for validating tokens.

methods.name: getTokenLifetime
methods.description: Returns the duration used for the 'exp' claim in tokens.

methods.name: isExpired
methods.description: Checks if a token is expired based on current time and allowed clock skew.

methods.name: isExpired
methods.description: Checks if a token is expired based on a specific instant.

methods.name: getExpiration
methods.description: Retrieves the expiration date ('exp' claim) from a JWT token.

methods.name: forSharedSecret
methods.description: Creates a JwtHelper instance configured with a shared secret for signing and validation.

methods.name: forSigning
methods.description: Creates a JwtHelper instance configured for signing JWTs based on provided configuration.

methods.name: forValidating
methods.description: Creates a JwtHelper instance configured for validating JWTs based on provided configuration.
